title: Existing section-module operations and pure-tensor data
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For a scheme $T$, use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the pulled-back ring $R_T$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], its reconstructed section ring, and the fixed section equivalence $E_T$ [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Retain the existing coefficient-ring map given on every section by the adjunct of the coefficient pullback. Let section-module direct image be ordinary sheaf direct image with scalar restriction along that map; let inverse image be presheaf scalar-extension pullback followed by sheafification, and retain its specified ringed module adjunction. The internal operations to compare are [def-sfb-module-upper-star], [def-sfb-module-lower-star], and [def-sfb-module-upper-lower-adjunction]. Retain the existing direct-image comparison that is the identity on sections, the inverse-image comparison uniquely fixed as its adjunction mate, and, for open immersions, the sectionwise extension by zero and its specified adjunction, with its uniquely mate-normalized comparison to [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. Retain the geometric fibre-product direct-image compositor of [def-sfb-module-lower-star-comp] and its inverse-image adjunction mate [def-sfb-module-upper-star-comp]. For the internal relative tensor [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor], the local pure tensor is the ambient sheafified abelian pure tensor followed by the balancing-coequalizer projection. For the section-module tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], it is the balanced section tensor followed by module sheafification and its canonical tensor identification. These are transparent aliases of the existing constructions, not further choices of operations or comparison maps. The site object universe is $u+1$, its morphism universe is $u$, and coefficient and module sections have universe $u+1$.
